Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Introduction
 At IBM, work is more than a job - it's a calling: To build. To design. To code. consult. To think along with clients and sell. To make markets. To invent. To collaborate. Not just to do something better, but to attempt things you've never thought possible. you ready to lead in this new era of technology and solve some of the world's most challenging problems? If so, lets talk.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 Design and optimize large-scale data platforms supporting high-throughput APIs and complex data catalogs with millions of daily transactions. Develop scalable data models, processing pipelines, and exposed data services using Java, SQL, Kafka, and Spark while ensuring performance, reliability, and stability. Collaborate with architects, analysts, and engineering teams to deliver secure and efficient data solutions, lead code reviews, support deployments, and troubleshoot critical production incidents within strict SLA targets.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and execute comprehensive tests, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Participate in user acceptance and solution validation activities.
Conduct code reviews for solutions developed by members of the squad.
Estimate development effort for new projects, enhancements, and change requests.
Coordinate and manage deployments across development, QA, and production environments.
 Preferred Education
 Bachelor's Degree
 Technical Skills
 Required technical and professional expertise
Essential: Strong SQL skills and solid experience with Java (>17).
Advanced: Performance tuning, optimization, and profiling.
Hands-on experience with, or strong familiarity with, technologies such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Oracle EXACC, Spark, Kubernetes, Starburst, Airflow, Python, ELK monitoring, and Docker.
Professional Skills
Strong attention to detail, autonomy, and a proactive approach to identifying and proposing solutions.
Ability to communicate progress and provide clear updates on assigned activities.
Customer-focused mindset with strong collaboration and problem-solving skills.
Results-oriented, with the ability to work effectively across teams and stakeholders.
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Workflow Orchestration: Familiarity with Apache Airflow for orchestrating, scheduling, and automating data pipelines.
Python Development: Experience with Python scripting for data engineering, ETL processes, and workflow automation.
API & Data Modeling: Knowledge of Swagger/OpenAPI for API documentation and Apache Avro for data serialization and schema management.
Monitoring & Observability: Familiarity with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log management, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Distributed Data Processing: Understanding of Starburst (Trino) and distributed SQL query engines for querying and integrating data across multiple sources.
